title.narrative: Financing and technology for food systems transformation

description.narrative: The “Financing and Technology in Food Systems” initiative aims to enhance economic opportunities and resilience for smallholder farmers through innovative financing and digital technologies. Smallholders and agribusinesses face constraints such as limited access to finance, markets, information, and inputs, which hinder their productivity and income, especially for women and youth. UNCDF will pilot this initiative with partners to demonstrate how financing and technology can overcome these barriers. The global partnership with the FAO Investment Centre on Digital Agriculture is in its early stages, with $0.6 million in initial funding and additional contributions expected from Chad and Senegal. This phase aims to establish a foundation for a sustainable food systems programme, leveraging UNCDF's expertise and developing opportunities in sustainable food systems and resilience. The objective is to create a robust programme with FAO, WFP, and potentially IFAD, positioning UNCDF as a central player in food systems financing.
